  ORDER BY ps.win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_losers AS (
  SELECT p.player_name, ps.loss_count
  FROM player_stats ps
  JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  ORDER BY ps.loss_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

FROM top_losers tl
